"''Just stay alive!|Wrobie Tyce and Poe Dameron during the Battle of Exegol|audio=Tyce-Dameron-StayAlive-TROS.flac|}} [[Lieutenant]] '''Wrobie Tyce''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] who served in the [[Resistance]]. The [[Marriage|wife]] of the human [[Larma D'Acy]], Tyce served as a [[courier]] [[pilot]] until D'Acy decided to join the Resistance movement, a venture that Tyce not only supported but also entered, flying in [[Cobalt Squadron]] in an [[RZ-2 A-wing interceptor]]. She escaped being [[Death|killed]] when the rest of her [[squadron]] perished at the [[Battle of D'Qar|retreat]] from the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]] in [[34 ABY]], as she was away on a separate mission. In [[35 ABY]], she was present on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]] for multiple meetings, including the [[funeral]] of [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and a session where plans were made for the [[Battle of Exegol]] against the [[Sith Eternal]]. She went on to pilot her [[A-wing starfighter]] at the battle, which began unfavorably for the Resistance as their expected reinforcements had not yet arrived. Just as the situation seemed particularly dire and General [[Poe Dameron]] was about to order a retreat, the [[Citizens' Fleet]] arrived, allowing the Resistance to destroy the Sith Eternal's [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyers]]. Tyce later celebrated the victory with her wife back on Ajan Kloss. ==Biography== ===Joining and serving the Resistance=== [[File:WrobieTyce-SWZ.png|thumb|left|300px|Wrobie Tyce pilots her RZ-2 A-wing through an asteroid field.]] The [[Marriage|wife]] of the [[human]] [[Larma D'Acy]], Wrobie Tyce was once a [[courier]] [[pilot]] operating on her [[homeworld]] of [[Warlentta]]. After D'Acy defended the [[Warlentta system]] for many [[Standard year|years]], she was personally recruited by [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] to the [[Resistance]] movement. Tyce was in full support, and she even chose to come along with her, changing from being a commercial pilot to [[Resistance pilot|one]] of [[Starfighter combat|combat]]. She went on to fly in the Resistance's [[Cobalt Squadron]], becoming a [[lieutenant]] and helping the unit defend the astronomical object [[Fabrin]] and the [[Nanth'ri Trade Route]]. Tyce and D'Acy were then among several married Resistance couples. Tyce was not present at the Resistance's [[Battle of D'Qar|retreat]] from the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]] in [[34 ABY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''—when the [[First Order]] had discovered the Resistance's [[Resistance base|hidden base]] and set out to destroy it—as she was away on a mission with fellow pilot [[Temmin Wexley|Snap Wexley]].{{Databank|resistance-pilots-biography-gallery|Resistance Pilots Biography Gallery}} {{C|Slide 15}} The rest of her [[squadron]] was [[Death|annihilated]] during the retreat, and Tyce was later reassigned under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of Wexley. Afterward, Tyce was greatly relieved as she learned that her [[Gender|wife]] had survived the [[Battle of Crait]], and she reunited with D'Acy following the battle. At some point, she flew her [[RZ-2 A-wing interceptor|A-wing interceptor]] through an [[asteroid field]].{{FFGXW2|set=Heralds of Hope Squadron Pack|cardname=Wrobie Tyce}} ===Ajan Kloss=== {{Quote|So, how do the ships take off?''"
"''They use a signal from a navigation tower, like this one.|Wrobie Tyce and Poe Dameron|audio=Tyce-Dameron-NavTower-TROS.flac|}} [[File:WrobieMeeting-TROS.png|thumb|right|300px|Tyce at the meeting on Ajan Kloss]] In [[35 ABY]],{{FilmDate|IX}} Tyce was stationed at the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance's base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]], which allowed her to spend [[time]] with her wife after several [[Standard month|months]] on separate missions. While on the moon, she mentored other pilots. Tyce was present on Ajan Kloss when Resistance member [[Poe Dameron]] confirmed that [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] had returned and was hiding in the [[Unknown Regions]] on a world called [[Exegol]], and she later stood next to the deathbed of General Organa during the latter's [[funeral]]. She then participated in a briefing where the [[Battle of Exegol]] was planned, during which she asked the new general, Dameron, how the [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]] of the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]], were able to take off. Dameron explained that they used a signal from a [[navigation tower]], and the former [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]] elaborated that the [[Exegol landing team|ground team]] would take the tower down, preventing the [[Star Destroyer]]s from leaving the [[atmosphere]]. Meanwhile, the [[YT-1300 light freighter|light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' would be sent to the [[Core Worlds]] in order to gather reinforcements. While standing by her [[interceptor]], Tyce was given a goodbye kiss by D'Acy.''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' ===Battle of Exegol=== ====The battle commences==== {{Quote|The navigation tower has been deactivated.|Wrobie Tyce|audio=Tyce-Deactivated-TROS.flac|}} [[File:Wrobie-DB.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Tyce in her A-wing at the Battle of Exegol]] Tyce and the Resistance [[starfighter]]s flew to Exegol using directions provided by the [[Jedi]]-in-[[Jedi training|training]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]]. When they arrived at the world, Tyce pointed out that neither the ''Falcon'' nor any additional allies had arrived yet. She flew her [[A-wing starfighter|A-wing]] during the battle and was part of the [[Exegol air team|attack force]] that intended to destroy the navigation tower. However, the tower was deactivated upon their arrival, which she pointed out as they approached it. Tyce further explained that the tower was therefore no longer transmitting a signal.''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' Finn then discovered that the source of the navigation signal had been transferred to the Sith fleet's [[command ship]], the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']]. When he suggested that the ship be designated as the ground team's new drop zone, Tyce questioned his intention to launch a ground invasion on a Star Destroyer in disbelief. Finn admitted that he did not want to, but stated that there was no other choice. Tyce and the other [[fighter wing]]s covered the ground team's [[Fortitude (transport)|troop carrier]] as it landed on the ''Steadfast''. Later in the battle, the Resistance pilots began to doubt whether any reinforcements would in fact arrive. When Dameron was asked by the [[Mon Calamari]] pilot [[Aftab Ackbar]] what they would do, he told them that they needed to damage the Sith Star Destroyers' [[cannon]]s themselves. Tyce wondered what their fighters would be able to do against Destroyers of their size; Dameron responded that they would just try to stay alive. When he asked if the pilots were with him, Tyce replied affirmatively. ====Reinforcements arrive==== {{Dialogue|Tyce|General, you won't make it.|Dameron|Trust me, I'm fast!|Calrissian|Not as fast as this ship.|attr=Tyce, Dameron, and Calrissian discuss saving Finn and Jannah|audio=Tyce-Dameron-Calrissian-TROS.flac|src=}} [[File:WrobieDacy-TROS.png|thumb|right|300px|Tyce and D'Acy reunite on Ajan Kloss.]] When many of the Resistance's fighters began to be shot down by the [[TIE/dg starfighter|Sith TIE fighters]], Tyce asked Dameron if they needed to retreat. Just as Dameron prepared to make such an order, the reinforcements of the [[Citizens' Fleet]] arrived under General [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian's]] leadership, and the ''Steadfast'' was destroyed by Finn and his crewmate [[Jannah]], with the rest of the Sith Star Destroyers also falling to the Resistance. When Dameron attempted to save the pair, who were still on the command ship, Tyce warned that he would not be able to make it back in time. Dameron insisted he was fast, but Calrissian flew in to do the job instead, reminding Dameron that he was not as fast as the general's [[Light freighter|ship]], the ''Millennium Falcon''. Tyce returned to Ajan Kloss with the rest of the Resistance and participated in the victory celebrations there along with D'Acy, whom she hugged and kissed for a long while. She also danced about during the festivities. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Alpha Leader, what are you doing?|Tyce worriedly asks what Dameron is trying to do|audio=Tyce-AlphaLeader-TROSJr.flac|}} [[File:WrobieTyceHelmet-TROSVD.png|thumb|left|250px|Tyce's flight helmet]] Tyce supported her wife, D'Acy, to the extent of joining the Resistance alongside her. After the Battle of Crait, Tyce was very relieved to hear that D'Acy had survived. The two found courage in each other's presence, though they were not prone to public displays of affection. When they were apart, with D'Acy working with [[Resistance Army|ground forces]] and Tyce on different missions in her A-wing, the couple were unsure of when they would be reunited; despite this, they were able to remain hopeful, inspired by General Organa who had said that "Nothing's impossible."''[[Star Wars: I Love You. I Know.]]'' During the Battle of Exegol, when Commander Dameron asked his starfighter pilots if they were with him, she assured him that she was without hesitation. When Dameron tried to save Finn and Jannah by himself, Tyce was worried for him and tried to tell him to stop. A particularly aggressive pilot, she had no trouble handling enemies at close range.{{FFGweb|url=en/news/2020/9/23/fight-to-the-finish|text=Fight to the Finish}} Tyce was a human female with curly, [[Color|black]] [[hair]], brown skin, and brown [[eye]]s. She stood 1.65 [[meter]]s (5 [[Foot|feet]], 5 inches) tall. ==Skills and abilities== Originally a courier pilot, Tyce was able to adapt her flying skills to pilot starfighters instead. She was also able to fly through [[asteroid]]s. ==Equipment== Tyce utilized a green-and-white RZ-2 A-wing interceptor. She also wore a white-and-red [[flight helmet]] that bore a yellow [[Rebel Alliance starbird]] and the logo of Cobalt Squadron but had room for a new decal. She donned an interstellar-orange''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' [[flight suit]] that had a [[utility belt]], emergency [[oxygen]] tube, and an equipment pocket. The suit was further covered in a white [[Flak vest|flight vest]] and was accompanied by a gray [[Guidenhauser]] [[flight harness]], a white [[FreiTek Incorporated]] [[life support]] unit, and black [[glove]]s and [[boot]]s. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Hey. I've just finished updating the training course, which is absolutely not my job, by the way. Leia asked Snap to do it and then he dumped it on me. I'm normally piloting starships but managed to have a little fun with this. I've made the course ridiculously hard. Want to try it?|Wrobie Tyce, in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga''|audio=WrobieTyce-LEGOTSS.flac|''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''}} Wrobie Tyce first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], where she was portrayed by [[Vinette Robinson]]. Her surname was revealed in the credits, and her first name was given in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. The [[2020]] [[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition|novelization]] of the film mistakenly describes Tyce's starfighter as a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-wing]]. The [[2021]] [[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Graphic Novel Adaptation|graphic novel adaptation]] for ''The Rise of Skywalker'' slightly modifies Tyce's dialogue,[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] changing "The navigation tower has been deactivated" to "The navigation tower! It's been deactivated!" At one point in the [[2022]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Character Encyclopedia, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'', she is mistakenly identified as "Tyce Wrobie." The celebratory kiss between Tyce and D'Acy was notable as the first on-screen [[Wikipedia:LGBT|LGBTQ+]] kiss in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' films. It was censored in the [[Wikipedia:United Arab Emirates|United Arab Emirates]]{{WebCite|url=https://www.looper.com/180490/the-one-rise-of-skywalker-scene-thats-being-censored|text=The One Rise Of Skywalker Scene That's Being Censored|author=White, Abbey|date=2019-12-20|archivedate=20191221152414}} and [[Wikipedia:Singapore|Singapore]].{{WebCite|url=https://deadline.com/2019/12/star-wars-rise-of-skywalker-same-sex-kiss-singapore-cut-1202816684|text='Star Wars' Same-Sex Kiss Edited Out In Singapore|author=Hipes, Patrick|date=2019-12-24|work=[[Wikipedia:Deadline Hollywood|Deadline Hollywood]]|archivedate=20210225213952}} Both Robinson and Larma D'Acy's actor, [[Amanda Lawrence]], described the kiss as "brilliant" and an important scene to feature.{{InsiderCite|226|Amanda Lawrence: A Commanding Performance}} Wrobie Tyce appears on Ajan Kloss in the [[2022]] non-[[canon]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'', where she gives players the racing mission "Tyce's Totally Tough Time Trial." Tyce tells the player that she had enjoyed updating the [[Ajan Kloss training course|Ajan Kloss Resistance base training course]], having been given the task by fellow pilot Snap Wexley, who was supposed to do it himself upon Leia Organa's instruction. Tyce further boasts that she had made the course extremely difficult and invites the player to use it. Completing the race within a short time limit unlocks Tyce as a playable character in-game. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Wrobie Tyce|imagecat=Images of Wrobie Tyce}} *[[Star Wars (2020) 25|''Star Wars'' (2020) 25]] {{C|Variant cover only}} *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} *[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (Disney Die-Cut Classics)|''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'' die-cut children's book]] *[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (Screen Comix)|''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'' Screen Comix]] *[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] *[[The Rise of Skywalker Adaptation 5|''The Rise of Skywalker Adaptation'' 5]] ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[William Shakespeare's The Merry Rise of Skywalker: Star Wars Part the Ninth]]'' *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Galactic Guide]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Wrobie}} *{{Topps|set=2020 Topps Women of Star Wars|cardname=Vinette Robinson as Tyce|link=https://picclick.co.uk/2020-Topps-Women-of-Star-Wars-Vinette-Robinson-303524006289.html}} *{{FFGweb|url=en/news/2020/9/23/fight-to-the-finish|text=Fight to the Finish}} *{{FFGXW2|set=Heralds of Hope Squadron Pack|cardname=Wrobie Tyce}} *{{InsiderCite|198|Launchpad}} {{Po}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Final Order and the Battle of Exegol}} *''[[Star Wars: I Love You.
